<h2 class="has-text-align-center heading-subline wp-block-heading">How to get to Shark Bay Western Australia?</h2>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">Fly to Perth International or Domestic airport</p>
<div class="gb-grid-wrapper gb-grid-wrapper-f3569061">
<div class="gb-grid-column gb-grid-column-140c18fa">
<div class="gb-container gb-container-140c18fa">
<div class="gb-inside-container">
<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-be9f9be4 gb-headline-text">Fly to Shark Bay</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From Perth (PER) Domestic<br />To<br />Monkey Mia (MJK)</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">2 hours</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Free Airport pick up</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="gb-grid-column gb-grid-column-20595fc7">
<div class="gb-container gb-container-20595fc7">
<div class="gb-inside-container">
<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-cabc95e1 gb-headline-text">Drive to Shark Bay</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From Perth<br />To<br />Denham</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">9 hours or 820kms</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">No 4WD required</p>
